import CERegistry from "/src/index.ts"; /** * The components below are loaded by the real registry — there is no stand-in * here. `catalog` maps each tag to a loader and `src/lifecycle.ts` paints the * walk itself, so what the CSS is hooked to is the shipped state machine: * * :not(:defined) → [ce=loading] → [ce=loaded] → [ce=defined] * └─ defer barrier ─┘ * * `loaded` is the window `deferDefine` opens: the module is in memory, the * batch has not upgraded yet. `defined` is written in the frame the element * upgrades, and is the last state of the success walk. */ /* ── components ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ const CARD = ` .inner { display: grid; gap: .3rem; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: inherit; } h3 { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; } p { margin: 0; font-size: .82rem; color: #64748b; } /* The component animates its own guts, keyed on the same attribute the page uses for the host box. */ :host([ce="defined"]) .inner > * { animation: ce-rise var(--ce-dur, 380ms) cubic-bezier(.16, 1, .3, 1) both; } :host([ce="defined"]) .inner > *:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 70ms; } @keyframes ce-rise { from { opacity: 0; translate: 0 6px; } } `; const ENTER = ` .inner { display: grid; gap: .3rem; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: inherit; } h3 { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; } p { margin: 0; font-size: .82rem; color: #64748b; } `; const ITEM = ` .inner { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: .6rem; height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; padding: .85rem 1rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: inherit; font-size: .85rem; } .dot { width: .6rem; height: .6rem; border-radius: 50%; background: #6366f1; flex: none; } `; const define = (css, html) => class extends HTMLElement { connectedCallback() { if (this.shadowRoot) return; this.attachShadow({ mode: "open" }).innerHTML = `${html}`; } }; const GROW = ` .inner { display: grid; gap: .3rem; box-sizing: border-box; height: 100%; padding: 1.1rem 1.25rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: inherit; } h3 { margin: 0; font-size: .95rem; } p { margin: 0; font-size: .82rem; color: #64748b; } `; const CLASSES = { "demo-card": define(CARD, `

Loaded component

Upgraded in place — the host faded, then the contents rose in.

`), "demo-enter": define(ENTER, `

Revealed by @starting-style

Never had a loading look; it went from nothing to rendered.

`), "demo-item": define(ITEM, `
Item upgraded with the batch
`), "demo-grow": define(GROW, `

Grown to its real height

The slot reserved 2.5rem. The component needs more than that, so the box animates to height: auto — and everything below it stays put.

`), }; /* ── the walk ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */ /** A loader that takes its time, so `loading` is a state you can see. */ const slow = (ctor) => async () => { await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 900)); return ctor; }; globalThis.registry = new CERegistry({ catalog: Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(CLASSES).map(([tag, ctor]) => [tag, slow(ctor)])), }); /* A defined tag cannot un-define itself, so a replay is a reload. */ document.getElementById("replay").addEventListener("click", () => location.reload());
